message.content:
**Microsoft FY2024 10-K read and reviewed — decision: BUY, order placed and filled.**

**What the filing showed (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, 10-K filed 2024-07-30):** total revenue of **$245.1 billion** (up 16% from $211.9B), gross margin $171.0B, operating income $109.4B (+24%), net income $88.1B (+22%), diluted EPS $11.80, and operating cash flow of $118.5B. Growth was broad-based across all three segments — Intelligent Cloud revenue +20% to $105.4B (Azure and other cloud services +30%), Productivity and Business Processes +12% to $77.7B (Office 365 Commercial +16%), and More Personal Computing +13% to $62.0B (Xbox content and services +50%, including ~44 points from the Activision Blizzard acquisition, which added $5.7B of revenue but a $1.4B operating loss in its partial year). Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $137.4B (+23%), commercial remaining performance obligation was $275B, and the balance sheet remains fortress-like with $75.5B in cash and short-term investments (against $51.2B face value of long-term debt). The main watch items I noted are the scaling AI/datacenter capex ($44.5B of additions to property and equipment, up from $28.1B) and the IRS Notices of Proposed Adjustment seeking $28.9B plus penalties and interest, which management is contesting. On that basis I judged the business quality and earnings trend supportive of adding to the position, so I bought **23 shares of MSFT at a limit of $420.50** (the quote was $420.18 last / $420.20 ask, so the limit was ~0.08% above market and filled at $420.50), for a total of **$9,671.50**. That stays within the mandate: MSFT is an approved name, buy-only, under the $10,000 per-order cap, well under the $20,000 daily cap (this was the only order today), no funds moved out of the account (cash of $50,000 was available), and the limit was set at the market. The position is now 123 shares of MSFT. Key figures relied on: FY2024 revenue $245,122M, operating income $109,433M, net income $88,136M, diluted EPS $11.80, operating cash flow $118,548M.
